title: Metronome with Web Audio scheduling
when: The user wants a metronome with adjustable tempo, time signature, accented first beat and tap tempo.
prompt:
Goal: Rock steady clicks scheduled on the audio clock, with visuals that follow the sound.
Steps:
1. Create the AudioContext on the first Start click; each click is an OscillatorNode (1000 Hz accent, 800 Hz others) through a GainNode with a 30 ms envelope.
2. Lookahead: every 25 ms schedule beats falling within the next 100 ms using audioContext.currentTime; timers never play sound directly.
3. logic.mjs: secondsPerBeat(bpm, subdivision), nextBeat(state), tapTempo(taps) averaging the last 4 intervals and resetting after 2 s, clampBpm 30 to 300.
4. Controls: linked number and range inputs for BPM, minus and plus, meter select (2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 6/8), Tap, Start and Stop with aria-pressed.
5. Beat dots driven by requestAnimationFrame from the scheduled times; under prefers-reduced-motion only change color.
6. Space toggles; last tempo and meter in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: 120 bpm is 0.5 s apart, accent on beat 0, tap average.
Quality bar:
- No drift over 10 minutes.
- Tempo changes apply on the next beat.
- Large controls for use at an instrument.
Pitfalls:
- setInterval clicks that drift and stutter.
- Creating a new AudioContext per click.
- Visual and audio out of sync.
Verify:
- [ ] Scheduler uses currentTime.
- [ ] Inputs labeled.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule present.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (audio and scheduler), logic.mjs (timing), test.mjs.

examples.output: 60 to 200 bpm, 3/4 and 4/4, accent beat 1, Tap tempo
